hero.headline: Viesulai
hero.subheadline: Third squad of the Honor Guard company

about.title: About us
about.p1: "Viesulai" is the third squad of the Lithuanian Riflemen's Union, uniting motivated citizens from across Lithuania who are committed to strengthening the country's defense capability and civic awareness.
about.p2: Our squad is part of the Lithuanian Riflemen's Union – a voluntary paramilitary civic self-defense organization active since 1919. The Riflemen's Union is one of the oldest and largest defense organizations in Lithuania.
about.p3: We bring together people of various professions and backgrounds, united by a shared value – the determination to defend our country and community.
about.p4: The squad's activities are organized and supported by VšĮ Trečiasis būrys (legal entity code 307633723) – a non-profit public institution with registered charity (paramos gavėjas) status. It uses donations only for the public-benefit purposes set out in its statutes.

ceremonies.title: Honor guard and ceremonies
ceremonies.description: As a squad of the Honor Guard company, we take part in national holidays and commemorations in Vilnius: flag-raising ceremonies and events honoring those who died for Lithuania's freedom.

training.title: Military and tactical training
training.description: Regular exercises and courses: tactics, land navigation, communications, and safe weapon handling. We train together with other Riflemen's Union units and the Lithuanian Armed Forces.

medical.title: First aid training
medical.description: Members learn tactical and civilian first aid – bleeding control, casualty rescue, and evacuation – and pass this knowledge on to the community.

drones.title: Drones and situational awareness
drones.description: We train drone operators and users of situational awareness systems (ATAK). These skills are also used for civil protection, such as searches for missing persons.

education.title: Civic education
education.description: We organize talks and meetings on crisis preparedness, civil protection, and resilience to disinformation, working with schools and local communities.

community.title: Community support
community.description: Together with public institutions, we volunteer in public order, search and rescue, and event safety activities.

project1.title: First aid kits for every member
project1.description: Using donations, we purchase individual first aid kits and run training on how to use them for all squad members.

project2.title: Drone and communications capability
project2.description: We train drone operators and deploy a situational awareness system and communications equipment so the squad can operate alongside other units.

project3.title: Open first aid sessions for the public
project3.description: Free hands-on sessions for Vilnius residents: bleeding control, CPR, and household crisis preparedness.

goal1.title: Defense readiness
goal1.description: We develop our members' military and tactical competencies to be prepared to act in critical situations.

goal2.title: Community
goal2.description: We build a strong and unified community where every member feels valued and needed.

goal3.title: Civic education
goal3.description: We strengthen civic awareness and patriotism, encouraging active participation in national defense.

step1.title: Become a rifleman
step1.description: The first step is to become a member of the Lithuanian Riflemen's Union. Register through the official website.

step2.title: Contact us
step2.description: Write us an email or fill out the form – we'll answer all your questions about our squad's activities.

step3.title: Submit a transfer request
step3.description: Fill out a transfer request at your regiment to officially join the Viesulai squad.

step4.title: Start your journey
step4.description: Participate in exercises, training sessions, and squad events together with the team.

support.title: Support the squad
support.subtitle: Your support helps us strengthen our defense readiness

gpm.title: 1.2% income tax support
gpm.description: When filing your annual income tax declaration, you can allocate 1.2% of your paid personal income tax to our squad. Search for company code 307633723 or the name "Trečiasis būrys" in the recipient search.

transfer.title: Bank transfer
transfer.description: Transfer your support to the bank account listed below. Payment purpose: PARAMA (Support).

business.title: Business support
business.description: If you represent a business and wish to contribute to our activities – we can arrange individual agreements. Support can be both financial and material.

usage.title: How donations are used
usage.description: All donations go only to the squad's activities: member training and exercises, first aid, protective and communications equipment, and civic education events. We file donation recipient reports with the State Tax Inspectorate (VMI).
